description:
Where each ancestry group lives: counts and shares for 29 ancestries (English, Irish, Chinese, Indian, Lebanese and more) in every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,000 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few residents for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/ancestry`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, australian_count, australian_pct, aboriginal_count, aboriginal_pct, english_count, english_pct, irish_count, irish_pct, scottish_count, scottish_pct, welsh_count, welsh_pct, german_count, german_pct, dutch_count, dutch_pct, french_count, french_pct, italian_count, italian_pct, greek_count, greek_pct, maltese_count, maltese_pct, spanish_count, spanish_pct, polish_count, polish_pct, russian_count, russian_pct, hungarian_count, hungarian_pct, croatian_count, croatian_pct, serbian_count, serbian_pct, macedonian_count, macedonian_pct, chinese_count, chinese_pct, indian_count, indian_pct, filipino_count, filipino_pct, vietnamese_count, vietnamese_pct, korean_count, korean_pct, sri_lankan_count, sri_lankan_pct, lebanese_count, lebanese_pct, south_african_count, south_african_pct, new_zealander_count, new_zealander_pct, maori_count, maori_pct, samoan_count, samoan_pct, other_ancestry_count, other_ancestry_pct, not_stated_count, not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
